Features and use cases

Explore the proposed workflow for each project.

MVP 01 / Unified Data Aggregator & Validator

Proposed features

  • Import PDF, Excel and CSV

    Extract tables and property listings from digital or scanned files. Retain the source document and page.

  • Capture listings and messages

    Process pasted text, screenshots and conversation exports from WhatsApp or Telegram.

  • Connect data sources

    Use local APIs or authorized exports. A US rollout could add Rentometer and later HelloData, subject to access.

  • Normalize rental terms

    Capture original currency, payment frequency, condo fees, advance rent, deposit, commission, floor area, furnishings, backup power and water supply. Keep missing values unknown.

  • Flag duplicates and anomalies

    Identify repeat listings, ambiguous currencies, inconsistent prices and missing fields. Assess unusual values against a sufficiently large set of similar properties.

  • Verify and approve records

    Review doubtful fields alongside evidence, confirm availability and add missing comparables.

  • Export traceable data

    Store approved records with source, retrieval date, verification status and change history.

Use cases 07

01Consolidate scattered comparables

Upload five PDFs, a spreadsheet and broker listings. Review them in a single table without retyping each property.

02Resolve an ambiguous currency

A listing says “1,200 per month.” Confirm the currency before using it in an analysis.

03Identify a duplicate property

Two sources list the same apartment at different prices. Review the match and confirm the current price.

04Compare rental conditions

Two apartments have the same rent. Capture whether condo fees are included and how much advance rent is required.

05Fill in a critical detail

Ask the broker whether backup power serves the unit or only common areas. Record the answer and date.

06Add a missing comparable

Add a relevant listing manually with its link, property details and authorized photos.

07Refresh existing comparables

Import updated data and review changes in price or availability before approving them.

MVP 02 / Report Generator & Market History

Proposed features

  • Reuse the existing template

    Convert the team’s current Claude report into a versioned template with defined fields.

  • Select a property and comparables

    Choose a city, area, building and unit. Review approved comparables before generating a report.

  • Generate analysis with the Claude API

    Draft explanations from approved data. Calculate medians, ranges and price per square meter in the application.

  • Find and attach property photos

    Retrieve photos from the office’s library or sources that allow reuse. Match them with property codes and verified references.

  • Review uncertain photo matches

    Send ambiguous matches to review and flag comparables that have no image.

  • Generate branded PDFs

    Apply the logo, colors, tables, photos, sources and reporting cutoff date in a consistent format.

  • Preserve each edition

    Keep the PDF, input data, comparable selection and template version for every report.

Archived PDFs would use company-owned or expressly licensed imagery.

Use cases 07

01Prepare a rental pricing proposal

Select a unit and approved comparables. Draft a proposed range with published prices, property features and a rationale.

02Populate the current template

Load fresh data and reuse the familiar report structure without rewriting formatting prompts.

03Place photos automatically

Find authorized photos associated with comparable IDs and insert them in the corresponding report sections.

04Prepare reports for multiple units

Reuse shared building data and tailor a separate report to each of ten apartments.

05Update a previous analysis

Open an earlier report, refresh the comparable set and issue a new edition while retaining the previous one.

06Explain a change in the estimate

Compare report versions to show the owner what changed in the sample and its prices.

07Review market trends by area

Inspect historical observations alongside comparable counts and sample composition.

MVP 03 / Leasing Activity & Portfolio Automation

Proposed features

  • Organize buildings and units

    Keep records of owners, assigned agents, availability, documents and reports.

  • Import leasing activity

    Use Excel, CSV or available integrations. US operations could use Zillow or Apartments.com exports. Venezuelan operations would use the office’s actual channels.

  • Log inquiries, calls and viewings

    Record activity by unit, date and channel. Distinguish scheduled, completed and canceled viewings.

  • Monitor performance

    Track interest, response times, follow-ups and conversion between stages.

  • Schedule recurring reports

    Set weekly, twice-monthly or every-other-month delivery based on the agreement with each owner.

  • Review and send

    Prepare reports for approval when required, send them through the configured channel and log the outcome.

  • Handle stale data and failures

    Flag outdated inputs, generation or delivery failures and pending retries. Prevent duplicate sends.

Use cases 07

01Send a weekly owner update

Combine current comparables and leasing activity in a report ready for approval and delivery.

02Find inquiries that stall before a viewing

Review recorded reasons and pending follow-ups when a listing generates many inquiries but few visits.

03Compare lead channels

Identify which channels produce inquiries and completed viewings when attribution is available.

04Manage reporting for hundreds of units

Filter by building, agent or status to see reports that are ready, missing data or already sent.

05Set different reporting schedules

Send weekly updates to one owner and twice-monthly updates to another.

06Pause reporting after a lease closes

Mark a unit as leased to stop recurring reports and keep its history.

07Retry a failed delivery

Review the failure and retry the send without regenerating the report or repeating successful deliveries.

Delivery scope

Approved comparables feed market reports, which become part of each unit’s leasing record.
